notes: On Windows and Linux, with Restore my previous clipboard after inserting on, a dictation that did not paste no longer takes the place of what you had copied: while Koegaki stays open, the next one that pastes puts back what you had copied, or anything you copied since. On Linux, dictating into a terminal on KDE Plasma or an X11 desktop now pastes: Koegaki presses Ctrl+Shift+V when Konsole, kitty, Alacritty or another terminal is in front, so the shell no longer waits on a stray Ctrl+V.
